decisive_items: Abdominal ultrasonography revealed an 11 × 7.5 × 11.2 cm predominantly anechoic, thick-walled lesion arising from the inferior surface of the liver

Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen demonstrated a well-defined, lobulated cystic lesion with a solid component in its superior part, abutting the colon and duodenum. The lesion was interpreted as an infected non-parasitic cyst.
response.rationale: The patient's presentation and imaging findings are most consistent with an infected non-parasitic liver cyst, which is supported by the ultrasonography and CT findings, as well as the clinical symptoms and laboratory results.

rejected.why: Although the patient has symptoms consistent with an abscess, the imaging findings are more consistent with a cystic lesion.
